derivation: or פְּדֻת; from H6929 (קֵדְמָה)lemma קדְמָה missing vowel, corrected to קֵדְמָה;

occurrences.text: And I will put a division between my people and thy people: to morrow shall this sign be.
He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.

Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because there is no water, and dieth for thirst.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
